content: द्वैधीभावः .²1 Duality, double state or nature. .²2 Separation into two, difference, diversity. .²3 Doubt, uncertainty, vacillation, suspense; धृतद्वैधीभावकातरं मे मनः <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. .²4 A dilemma. .²5 One of the six Guṇas or modes of foreign policy. (According to some authorities it means ‘double dealing’, or ‘duplicity’ ‘keeping apparently friendly relations with the enemy’; द्वैधीभाविकाः सन्धिविग्रहाः <ls>Kau. A. 7</ls>; बलिनोर्द्विषतोर्मध्ये वाचात्मानं समर्पयन् . द्वैधीभावेन तिष्ठेत्तु काकाक्षिवदलक्षितः .. According to others it means ‘dividing oneʼs army and encountering a superior enemy in detachments’, ‘harassing the enemy by attacking them in small bands’; द्वैधीभावः स्वबलस्य द्विधाकरणम् <ls>Mit.</ls> on <ls>Y. 1. 347</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>Ms. 7. 173</ls> and <ls n="Ms. 7.">160</ls>.) .²6 A contest, dispute. .²7 Falsehood, duplicity.
